description: Graphite sketch of young man's head (the artist's brother) in profile, facing toward the left side of the paper. Drawing positioned in center of paper surrounded by negative space, light shading against the profile. Signed and dated directly below lower right of drawing.
title: Untitled (Francis O'Keeffe)
